title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
altTitles: 俺だけレベルアップな件: ラグナロク
description: Sung Suho, the son of Sung Jinwoo, lives an ordinary life as a college student until a near-death experience awakens the dormant powers and memories within his bloodline. As mysterious gates once again unleash monsters upon Earth and the Itarim threaten the world, Suho must conquer the Shadow Dungeon, inherit his father's legacy, and become a powerful Hunter capable of facing a new threat.
author: Daul / JIN / Brix
